entries.note: Carbon Brief (23 Nov 2026) reports the Antalya pact cover decision was rejected by at least 32 countries in the closing plenary on Sunday 22 Nov, so it was never gavelled; the final gavel at 19:33 local time closed the COP with other items adopted but no cover decision. I read only this one outlet and did not check a second.
No cover decision was adopted in the window, so under the criterion this is NO. The rejected final draft also lacked a clear fossil-fuel reference, which was a main reason for the rejections.
